feeds.title: I love the Psalms Blog
feeds.description: Connecting daily with God through the Psalms. David Kitz is an actor, an award winning author, and a retired public school teacher. For over twenty-five years, he has served as an ordained minister with the Foursquare Gospel Church of Canada.

feeds.title: Psalms And Psimilar Blog
feeds.description: The psalter and many canticles in meters, with tunes to sing them to without worrying about copyright or paying fees. This site provides a downloadable psalter in meters, with at least one suggested theme for each psalm, designed so that ordinary people can sing them. They are on the page 'How to find what you are looking for'.

feeds.title: Twynham Church Blog » Psalms
feeds.description: Twynham Church as we know it today, began in a thatched cottage in Bargates in the 1860s by Miss Lestrange, who had a heart for the area's children. Read articles and blog posts about psalms written by different authors giving detailed information about them with their in-depth meaning.

feeds.title: Celtic Psalms Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Celtic Psalms, the homepage for four stunning albums by Kiran Young Wimberly & The McGraths. Kiran Young Wimberly & The McGraths have performed in Ireland and in North America, and their music has been featured on Irish (RTE) and British (BBC) national television and radio.

feeds.title: Thomas Creedy's Blog » Psalms
feeds.description: I'm Tom, a 29-year-old follower of Jesus. I blog because I think I have something to say. I'm understanding more and more about Jesus every day - and realizing the effect my sin has on my life. Explore Psalms blogs, where I write book reviews, and discover how the Psalms connect to God's people today.

feeds.title: Douglas Wilson Blog » Psalms
feeds.description: My name is Douglas Wilson, The point of this blog is pretty broad - 'All of Christ for all of life.' In order to make that happen, we need 'theology that bites back.' In my psalms blogs, you will find detailed articles about psalms and bring that attitude to bear on education, sex, culture, theology, politics, book reviews, postmodernism, and expository studies, along with other random tidbits that come into my head.
